title: Backup scope · types
expect: Persistent media types use shared leading-label/trailing-switch rows, without search or selection summary. The last included type is disabled.
All leading symbols occupy one fixed column; Burst aligns with Photo, Live Photo and Video.
Edits persist at once; no Save or Done.

actions.action: Toggle Burst, use system Back, then reopen. Repeat with accessibility text and a long localization.
actions.result: Selection persists; titles align and rows grow without truncation.
